indications.note: 2-5y: 1.25mg SD. 6-11y: 2.5mg SD. >12y/Adult: 5mg SD. Metabolite of loratadine. Minimal sedation.

indications.label: Allergy
indications.note: 5mg OD for 2-5y, 10mg OD for >6y.

indications.label: Neurology
indications.note: Seizures. Longer acting than diazepam.

indications.label: Emergency
indications.note: Asthma/Torsades. Monitor DTRs & resp.

indications.label: Severe Asthma/Preeclampsia/Hypomagnesemia
indications.note: Dissolve in 5% Dextrose over 1 hr. Monitor deep tendon reflexes, RR, urine output. Antidote: Calcium gluconate.

indications.label: Cerebral Edema/Increased ICP
indications.note: 5 ml/kg over 30 min. Monitor serum osmolality, electrolytes, urine output. Contraindicated in pulmonary edema/severe dehydration.

indications.label: Meningitis/Sepsis
indications.note: Meningitis: 40 mg/kg/dose TDS. Dissolve in 20-30ml IV fluid, infuse over 1 hr. Broad-spectrum carbapenem.

indications.label: Antibiotics
indications.note: Broad spectrum. Meningitis dose may be higher.

indications.label: Severe/Resistant Bacterial Infection
indications.note: AUDIT: Meningitis dose 40mg/kg/dose q8h. Reserve for ESBL/resistant pathogens. Infuse over 15-30 min.

indications.label: Endocrine
indications.note: Not for <10 yrs. Lactic acidosis risk.

indications.label: Leukemia/Autoimmune Diseases
indications.note: Folate supplementation required (except on MTX day). Monitor CBC, LFTs, renal function. Teratogenic.

indications.label: Hemato-Oncology
indications.note: Cytotoxic. Folic acid supplementation required.

indications.label: Respiratory
indications.note: Severe asthma. Taper after acute phase.

indications.label: Gastro/Other
indications.note: Prokinetic. EPS risk. Limit duration.

indications.label: Cardiovascular
indications.note: Beta blocker. Heart failure dosing.

indications.label: Anaerobic/Protozoal Infections
indications.note: Amoebiasis: 10 mg/kg/dose TDS x 5 days. Giardiasis: 5 mg/kg/dose TDS x 5 days. Avoid alcohol.

indications.label: Antibiotics
indications.note: Anaerobic coverage. CNS penetration.

indications.label: Antibiotics
indications.note: Oral route. Metallic taste common.

indications.label: Anaerobic/Amebic Infection
indications.note: AUDIT: Avoid in neonates <4 weeks (immature hepatic clearance). Risk of peripheral neuropathy with prolonged use.

indications.label: Antifungals
indications.note: Oral thrush. Apply to affected areas.

indications.label: Neurology
indications.note: Sedation/Seizure. Paradoxical agitation possible.

indications.label: Seizures/Sedation
indications.note: AUDIT: Rapid onset. High apnea risk in neonates/premature. Requires resuscitation equipment nearby.

indications.label: Allergic Rhinitis/Asthma Prophylaxis
indications.note: 6-14y: 5mg. >15y/Adult: 10mg. 2-5y: 4mg chewable. Monitor for neuropsychiatric events (FDA warning).

indications.label: Respiratory
indications.note: Leukotriene ant. Take in evening.

indications.label: Severe Pain
indications.note: Monitor respiration & sedation. Titrate carefully.

indications.label: General Supplementation/Growth
indications.note: 1m-1y: 2.5ml. 1y-4y: 5ml. >4y: 7.5ml. Contains Vit A/D; avoid hypervitaminosis.

indications.label: Hypertensive Emergency/Raynaud's
indications.note: 0.5-1 mg/kg/day. Avoid sublingual administration (risk of precipitous hypotension). Monitor HR/BP.

indications.label: Cardiovascular
indications.note: Calcium channel bl. Do not crush.

indications.label: Analgesics
indications.note: Hepatotoxicity risk. Use only if 1st line fails.

indications.label: Cryptosporidium/Giardia
indications.note: Age-based dosing: 1-4y: 100mg, 4-11y: 200mg, Adult: 500mg. Course: 3 days. Take with food.

indications.label: Antibiotics
indications.note: UTI. Poor systemic absorption.

indications.label: Oral Candidiasis
indications.note: Infant: 1ml QDS. Child/Adult: 2-3ml QDS. Hold in mouth 30 sec before swallowing. Not absorbed systemically.

indications.label: Antifungals
indications.note: Oral thrush. Swish & swallow.

indications.label: Gastro/Other
indications.note: PPI. Administer before meals.

indications.label: Chemotherapy/Post-op/Gastroenteritis Vomiting
indications.note: 6m-1y: 2mg BD. >1y: 4mg BD. 4-11y: 4mg TDS. IV: 0.1 mg/kg/dose TDS. QT prolongation risk; monitor ECG in cardiac patients.

indications.label: Gastro/Other
indications.note: Vomiting. QT prolongation risk.

indications.label: Chemotherapy-Induced/Post-Op Nausea
indications.note: AUDIT: Off-label <6 months for gastroenteritis. QT prolongation risk—avoid with other QT-prolonging drugs. IV infusion over ≥15 min.

indications.label: Antivirals
indications.note: Influenza. Start within 48h of symptoms.

indications.label: Neurology
indications.note: Focal seizures. Hyponatremia risk.

indications.label: Gastro/Other
indications.note: PPI. IV route preferred NPO.

indications.label: Musculoskeletal
indications.note: Synergistic effect. Monitor total paracetamol.

indications.label: Strep Pharyngitis/Skin Infections
indications.note: Standard dosing aligns with BNFc. Ensure full 10-day course for strep pharyngitis to prevent rheumatic fever.

indications.label: Dermatological
indications.note: Wash after 8-12h. Repeat in 7 days.

indications.label: Allergic Reactions/Pruritus
indications.note: <1y: 7.5mg BD/TDS. 1-5y: 7.5-15mg BD/TDS. 5-12y: 15-22.5mg BD/TDS. Sedating. Use caution with CNS depressants.

indications.label: Neurology
indications.note: Neonatal seizures. Slow IV push.

indications.label: Neurology
indications.note: Maintenance. Monitor levels.

indications.label: Neonatal Seizures
indications.frequency: Loading IV over 20 min, then 3-5mg/kg/day maintenance
indications.note: AUDIT: First-line for neonates. Monitor levels (15-40 mcg/ml). Long half-life; accumulation risk.

indications.label: Status Epilepticus/Neonatal Seizures
indications.note: Load: 20 mg/kg. Maintenance after 12h: 5 mg/kg/day BD. Dilute with 9ml DW for injection. Monitor respiratory depression.

indications.label: Nasal Congestion
indications.note: Decongestant. Not recommended <6 years.

indications.label: Seizure Prophylaxis/Status
indications.note: IV: Dilute 100mg in 8ml DW. Load: 20 mg/kg. Maintenance: 5 mg/kg/day BD. Infuse <25 mg/min to avoid cardiac arrhythmias. Monitor levels.

indications.label: Neurology
indications.note: Monitor cardiac. Infusion rate <1mg/kg/min.

indications.label: Neurology
indications.note: Maintenance. Non-linear kinetics.

indications.label: Acute Seizures (Alternative to Phenytoin)
indications.note: 150mg PE = 100mg Phenytoin. Safer IV profile (no propylene glycol). Monitor for pruritus/paresthesia.

indications.label: Thrombocytopenia/Active Bleeding
indications.note: Expected rise: ~50,000/µL per unit. Use within 24h of issue. Monitor for febrile reactions, alloimmunization.

indications.label: Hypokalemia
indications.note: Syrup trick: wt/2 ml BD/TDS. Never give IV bolus. Max IV infusion 0.5 mEq/kg/hr. Monitor ECG & serum K+.

indications.label: Supplements
indications.note: 3 mmol/kg/dose. Dilute well.

indications.label: Inflammatory/Autoimmune Conditions
indications.note: Typical dose 1-2 mg/kg/day. Taper if used >10 days. Monitor for growth suppression, hyperglycemia, immunosuppression.

indications.label: Respiratory
indications.note: 3-5 day course. Equivalent to prednisone.

indications.label: Nephrotic Syndrome/Severe Asthma
indications.note: AUDIT: Taper slowly to avoid adrenal crisis. Monitor BP, glucose, growth velocity. Give with food.

indications.label: Respiratory
indications.note: Steroid. Hepatic conversion to prednisolone.

indications.label: Allergies/Vomiting/Sedation
indications.note: 6m-1y: 1-2.5ml BD. 1-5y: 1-2.5ml BD. >5y: 2-5ml BD. HIGHLY SEDATING. Contraindicated <2y due to respiratory depression risk.

indications.label: Cardiovascular
indications.note: Beta blocker. Asthma contraindication.

indications.label: Gastro/Other
indications.note: Fiber. Mix with water. Not <6 yrs.

indications.label: Pinworm/Ascariasis
indications.note: Syrup trick: wt x 0.22 ml. Repeat in 2 weeks for pinworm. Safe in children >6 months.

indications.label: Supplements
indications.note: Deworming. Repeat in 2 weeks.

indications.label: Neurology
indications.note: B6 dependent seizures. High dose trial.

indications.label: Severe Malaria
indications.note: Unconscious patients only. Dilute in D5W/NS. Monitor ECG (QT prolongation) and glucose (hypoglycemia risk).

indications.label: GERD/Peptic Ulcer
indications.note: AUDIT: Off-label in children <12 months. Omeprazole or Pantoprazole preferred in peds. Capsule not crushable.

indications.label: Acute Diarrhea
indications.note: AUDIT: Enkephalinase inhibitor; reduces stool output. Adjunct to ORS/Zinc. Avoid if bloody diarrhea/fever.

indications.label: GERD/Peptic Ulcer
indications.note: Infants/Children: 2-4 mg/kg/day TDS. Neonate: 1 mg/kg/dose TDS. Note: FDA recalled ranitidine in 2020 due to NDMA impurity; use alternatives (famotidine) where possible.

indications.label: Gastro/Other
indications.note: H2 blocker. Dose adjusted for renal.

indications.label: GERD/Peptic Ulcer Prophylaxis
indications.note: AUDIT: Off-label <1 month. IV infusion rate ≤25mg/min. Consider PPIs (omeprazole) as first-line per BNFc 2024.

indications.label: Antivirals
indications.note: Severe RSV. Teratogenic risk.

indications.label: Acute/Chronic Bronchospasm
indications.note: Age dosing: 2-6y: 1-2mg TDS. 6-12y: 2mg TDS. >12y: 2-4mg TDS. Nebulized preferred for acute attacks.

indications.label: Respiratory
indications.note: Acute asthma. Max 5mg per dose.

indications.label: Acute Asthma/Bronchospasm
indications.note: AUDIT: Monitor HR, K+, tremor. Nebulizer preferred over syrup for acute distress.

indications.label: Bronchospasm (Enantiomer-specific)
indications.note: 6-11y: 1mg TDS. Adult: 1-2mg TDS. Similar efficacy to salbutamol with potentially fewer side effects.

indications.label: Infant Colic/Gas
indications.note: <2y: 20mg/dose (0.3ml/5 drops) QDS. 2-12y: 40mg/dose (0.6ml/10 drops) QDS. Inert, acts locally. Safe in infants.

indications.label: Musculoskeletal
indications.note: Spasticity. Taper gradually.

indications.label: Metabolic Acidosis/Cardiac Arrest
indications.note: Mix with equal DW. Infuse slowly over 5 min. Calculate based on ABG/base deficit. Risk of hypernatremia, intracellular acidosis, hypokalemia.

indications.label: Emergency
indications.note: Acidosis. Calculate based on base deficit.

indications.label: Metabolic Acidosis/Cardiac Arrest
indications.note: AUDIT: Must dilute for peripheral IV. Administer slowly. Correct underlying cause first. Monitor ABGs.

indications.label: Cardiovascular
indications.note: K-sparing diuretic. Hyperkalemia risk.

indications.label: Hospital-acquired Pneumonia/Intra-abdominal
indications.note: Dose refers to piperacillin component. Monitor renal/hepatic function. High sodium content (~2.35 mEq/g).

indications.label: Gram-positive Infections
indications.note: Loading dose BD for first day, then maintenance once daily. Less nephrotoxic than vancomycin.

indications.label: Tetanus Prophylaxis/Treatment
indications.note: Prophylaxis: 4 IU/kg IM. Treatment: 500-3000 IU IM (max 6000). Administer at separate site from tetanus toxoid.

indications.label: Antibiotics
indications.note: Not for <8 yrs. Photosensitivity.

indications.label: Chronic Asthma/COPD
indications.note: Age-adjusted: 6w-6m: 10 mg/kg/day. 6m-1y: 12-18 mg/kg/day. 1y-12y: 20-24 mg/kg/day. High interaction potential. Monitor levels.

indications.label: Respiratory
indications.note: Monitor levels. Narrow therapeutic index.

indications.label: Biliary/Renal Colic/GI Spasm
indications.note: Antispasmodic. Syrup dosing: 1 mg/kg/day TDS. Monitor for anticholinergic effects.

indications.label: Gastro/Other
indications.note: Antispasmodic. Avoid in glaucoma.

indications.label: Neurology
indications.note: Seizures. Cognitive slowing risk.

indications.label: Analgesics
indications.note: Moderate to severe pain. Monitor for seizure threshold.

indications.label: Cholestatic Liver Disease/Gallstone Dissolution
indications.note: 10-15 mg/kg/day. Take with food. Monitor LFTs. Improves bile flow.

indications.label: Antivirals
indications.note: VZV. Prodrug of acyclovir.

indications.label: Neurology
indications.note: Broad spectrum. Hepatotoxicity & pancreatitis risk.

indications.label: Generalized/Tonic-clonic Seizures
indications.note: Max 60 mg/kg/day. Syrup trick: wt/4 ml BD/TDS. Monitor LFTs, CBC, ammonia levels. Teratogenic.

indications.label: MRSA/Severe Gram-positive Infections
indications.note: Infuse over 1 hr (20-30ml diluent) to prevent Red Man Syndrome. TDM essential (trough 10-20 mcg/mL).

indications.label: Antibiotics
indications.note: Check trough levels. Infuse over 60-90 min.

indications.label: Hemato-Oncology
indications.note: Neurotoxicity risk. FATAL if given intrathecally.

indications.label: Supplements
indications.note: High dose prophylaxis. Do not exceed.

indications.label: Deficiency/Convalescence
indications.note: <2y: 5ml SD. >2y: 5ml TDS. Inj: 5 units in 100ml saline. Generally safe, turns urine yellow.

indications.label: Appetite/Deficiency Support
indications.note: <10kg: 5ml daily. 10-30kg: 5ml BD/TDS. >30kg: 5ml TDS. Monitor zinc levels if prolonged.

indications.label: Combined Deficiency/Anemia
indications.note: 5ml TDS for infants/children. Avoid concurrent dairy. Monitor for GI side effects from iron.

indications.label: Supplements
indications.note: Deficiency. IM/SC route.

indications.label: Scurvy/Immune Support
indications.note: <4y: ¼ adult dose. 4-12y: ½ adult dose. High doses may cause GI upset or oxalate stones.

indications.label: Supplements
indications.note: Scurvy. Water soluble.

indications.label: Endocrine
indications.note: Supplement. Prevents rickets.

indications.label: Supplements
indications.note: Antioxidant. Fat soluble.

indications.label: Hemorrhagic Disease of Newborn/Vitamin K Deficiency
indications.note: Neonate: 1mg IM/PO. >3m: 5-10mg. Adult: 10-20mg. Essential for neonatal prophylaxis. IV use requires slow administration.

indications.label: Supplements
indications.note: HDN prophylaxis. IM stat neonate.

indications.label: Neonatal Hemorrhagic Disease Prophylaxis
indications.note: AUDIT: Standard WHO/UNICEF protocol. Preterm <1.5kg: 0.5mg. IV use only for active bleeding (slow infusion, anaphylaxis risk). Store protected from light.

indications.label: Diarrhea/Deficiency
indications.note: <6m: 10mg/day. 6m-5y: 20mg/day. WHO recommends 10-14 days for diarrhea. Syrup trick: wt/4 ml BD.

indications.label: Supplements
indications.note: For diarrhea. Take with food.

indications.label: Acute Diarrhea
indications.note: AUDIT: WHO standard. <6 months: 10mg/day. Reduce vomiting/duration. Give after food to avoid nausea.
